hero_body: I identify news opportunities to get attorneys quoted in mainstream media and trade publications, prepare them for media interviews, manage media attention around high-stakes litigation, and position their firms for long-term credibility. If you're a law firm partner, managing partner, or legal executive looking to sharpen your media strategy, whether preparing for reporter interviews or positioning your firm to stand out across AI and search platforms, contact me.
philosophy_quote: I work with clients who have real accomplishments and value clear, accurate communication. I don't do spin, high-volume noise, or predetermined messaging. Tools can speed up the process, but credible communication still depends on critical thinking, lived experience, and testing assumptions before speaking. If you value that standard, let's talk.

services.title: Communications
services.description: Clear, focused messaging that turns complex matters into plain English and creates opportunities for attorneys and executives to share their expertise.

services.title: Media Relations
services.description: Direct outreach to reporters and newsrooms to secure earned coverage in mainstream media and legal trades.

services.title: AI Visibility
services.description: Structuring your public record, published work, and media coverage so tools such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google cite your expertise accurately.

about_text: Before advising attorneys on public relations, I spent years in Southern California newsrooms across print, digital, television, and radio. I've worked at the Los Angeles Times, Los Angeles Daily News, Southern California Public Radio (KPCC.org), Thomson Reuters, and NBC4 Southern California, the NBC affiliate in Los Angeles (KNBC-TV). I know what reporters need and how assignment editors evaluate pitches on tight deadlines. Now, I connect journalists with attorneys offering clear insight and expert analysis on meaningful changes in the law and important legal issues of the day.

faqs.answer: I manage high-stakes media interest, draft clear press releases and statements, and protect client reputations during complex legal disputes and courtroom proceedings.
